## Esoteric Enforcer (CR 19)

**307,200**  
 Gillman warpriest 20  
 CE Medium humanoid  
 **Init** +8; **Senses** Perception +13  

**Defense**

 **AC** 31, touch 21, flat-footed 23 (+8 armor, +5 deflection, +4 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 insight, +2 natural)

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., 30 ft. swim

 **Ranged** +5 anarchic frost hand crossbow +37/+37/+32/+27/+22 (2d8+11/19–20/×3 plus 2d6 vs. law and 1d6 cold)  
 **Special Attacks** aspect of war, blessings 13/day (Evil: unholy strike, battle companion; Madness: control madness, madness

 At will—enthrall (uses 2 fervor) (DC 17)

 6th—antilife shell, cold ice strike (DC 21), harm (DC 21), symbol of fear (DC 21), word of recall  
5th—break enchantment, dispel good, major curse (DC 20), slay living (2, DC 20), spell resistance

2nd—darkness, grace, hold person (DC 17), silence (DC 17), surmount affliction (2)  
1st—abundant ammunition, bane, comprehend languages, divine favor, entropic shield, obscuring mist, shield of faith  
 0 (at will)—detect magic, guidance, light, read magic, resistance
